summary: built from the same parametric source with fdm=True and exported: identical outer envelope, 1.200 mm wall (3 perimeters at a 0.4 mm nozzle), every sliding fit opened 0.200 mm. NOT PRINTED and NOT QUEUED to any printer. It will be markedly quieter than the moulded shell: 1.20 mm of PC is 3.4x the bending stiffness of 0.80 mm and the exciter authority falls from 0.662 to 0.196.
